description: Get the full details for a specific product on authority.md — a persona framework, a functional Tool, a Playbook, or a curated Bundle. Use after search_personas to show complete information before purchase. Returns metadata, a 'type' field, and a preview of the content. Accepts persona slugs (e.g. 'warren-buffett'), Tool slugs (e.g. 'decision-brief'), Playbook slugs (e.g. 'invoice-chase'), and Bundle slugs (e.g. 'founder-stack'). For bundles, returns the full list of persona slugs needed to call purchase_persona.

slug.description: A persona slug (e.g. 'warren-buffett'), a skill slug (e.g. 'strategic-email'), a playbook slug (e.g. 'invoice-chase'), or a bundle slug (e.g. 'founder-stack').

name: get_persona_details
